notes.title: Flame Keeper 1.0 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/52400f84bf44a00f62793528333a39baf2dec0ab.png[/img]

The moment you've all been waiting for is finally here! Flame Keeper is blazing out of early access and into full release with version 1.0, hotter than a summer BBQ!

Get ready to ignite your gaming spirit as we introduce the Prophet, a wise villager who's seen more than a few winters and will guide you through the world of Flame Keeper!

But wait, there's more! Ascend to the Cloud biome, where you'll find icy islands that make winter wonderlands look like beach vacations. Watch your step, though, because the bridges are as treacherous as a shopping mall on Black Friday, and the spirits guarding them aren't handing out any deals!

The new biome is full of upgrades that will unlock new buildings for your village, so of course - it’s guarded by a brand-new boss as well!

So, grab your controllers (or whatever you’re playing with), and let's light up the world of Orbis together! Flame Keeper 1.0 is not just an update; it's a new adventure waiting to set your hearts on fire!

[previewyoutube=jNcQ00AGMoQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[b]New content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Story driven by cutscenes that are unlocked after finishing every region
[*] New villager - Prophet that helps us to get known with surrounding world by dialogue system
[*] New biome - Clouds. It consists of icy islands connected by dangerous bridges guarded by hostile spirits
[*] New resource available on Cloud biome that unlocks more buildings upgrades
[*] Cloud biome boss
[*] Audio: spiders explosion
[*] Traditional Chinese and Japanese translations
[/list]
[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Runes drop rate increased
[*] Settings and buildings descriptions text size increased
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Tree Spider now fires a single projectile instead of a stacked double projectile, making it easier to deflect
[*] Runes building - upgrades amount label
[*] Platforms desynchronization on desert stage
[*] Lamps, runes, gears - labels position after dropping down
[/list]

notes.title: Update 02 Release Notes
notes.content:
Dear Flame Keeper Adventurers,

We're thrilled to present you with the latest update including some improvements and fixes!

[b]What's New:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Hungarian Language Support:[/b] The realm of Flame Keeper now welcomes Hungarian-speaking heroes! Immerse yourself in the adventure with our fully localized Hungarian version.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Game Pause Fix:[/b] Good news for our Xbox controller users! We've resolved the pesky issue where pressing the B button caused a pause hiccup with no output. Enjoy uninterrupted gameplay!
[*] [b]Final Boss Fix:[/b] Prepare for an epic battle like never before! We've patched the problem where using fast bullets or precise bullets resulted in no damage taken during the final confrontation. Now, your skills and bravery will be truly tested.
[/list]

We extend our deepest gratitude to all the Flame Keeper players who have embarked on this heroic journey with us. Your unwavering support and valuable feedback inspire us to continue refining the game and crafting new adventures for you to conquer!

Stay vigilant, brave adventurers, our journey is far from over. More challenges and adventures await!

Best,
Untold Tales and Kautki Cave

notes.title: What the F…lame is going on with the game?
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Flame Keeper Community![/h3]

[b]🔥 First of all, we want to apologize for our lack of communication lately.[/b] 
We understand that it's important to keep you informed about the progress of Flame Keeper, and we're sorry for any frustration this may have caused. Please know that we've been fully focused on the game's production, which, of course, doesn't justify our silence.

[b]🔥 Now, let's address the burning question: has Flame Keeper been abandoned?[/b] 
Absolutely not! We are a small team of just three people, but we're incredibly passionate about providing you with a gaming experience that's nothing short of awesome. For us, quality isn't just a box to tick— we want it to be the heart of our work. So while some parts of the game might need a bit more time to nurture, we promise it's all to make sure you get the smoothest, most polished playtime possible.

[b]🔥 We're thrilled to announce that we have some exciting updates coming your way soon.[/b] 
By the end of the summer, we'll be releasing a patch for the Nintendo version of the game, which will include all the fixes and additional content from the current Steam version. We want all players to have a consistent and enjoyable experience regardless of their platform.

[b]🔥 And now, for the cherry on top, we have a sneak peek for you![/b] 
Introducing Biome 3 - “The Swamp”, a brand-new environment that we've been working tirelessly to bring to life. Get ready for a whole new level of exploration and challenges as you venture into this intriguing and treacherous biome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/e36fa6f493d64fbe984c0b642491d34366a97bbd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/ea4c0e7212829a5a42f576ce116c24a889258988.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/74115cf3bee7b7e8e89cfd7b16abbacffc1124bf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/1a92aecea4267cb2d560c4d040ebfc6c70bc18a2.png[/img]

You all have been amazing, seriously, and we promise to keep you updated more regularly moving forward. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we continue to make progress on Flame Keeper. We've got some really cool things in the pipeline and we're itching to share. You're gonna love what's coming.

Stay tuned, Flame Keepers!

[i]Best,
Untold Tales and Kautki Cave[/i]

notes.title: Update 01 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, fellow protectors of Orbis![/h3]

We're excited to announce the release of Update 01 for Flame Keeper! This update brings a host of new features, improvements, and bug fixes to the game. Here's a rundown of what's new:

[b]Perks[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 6 multi-level perks (3 levels each) and 17 single-level perks
[*] Players can select a random perk after each lamp charge
[*] Perks window displays after lamp charged
[*] Active perk icons are visible under HP bar
[/list]
[b]Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 9 new weapons dropping from totems and some enemies
[*] Three groups of weapons, each with its own effect on the last combo hit
[*] Each weapon type overrides basic melee attack and changes speed, damage, and range
[*] The forge building in the village can be upgraded to unlock new weapon drops
[*] Added weapon throwing (hold strong attack button)
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies now respawn after the player gains a perk
[*] Modified and wrapped the stamina bar around Ignis for better visibility
[*] Added two additional difficulty levels
[*] Made small translation tweaks
[*] Added widescreen support
[*] Added the ability to run the game in the background
[*] Improved dropped item visibility
[*] Improved opened totems FX (old ones were too intense and blocked visibility)
[*] Decreased the intro volume
[*] Fixed various bugs, including Vulpis dropping less energy than collected, desynchronized platforms preventing walking through wind zone, and missing textures on some assets
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the new features and improvements in Update 01! As always, we appreciate your feedback and support. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cYVNyfdwtq]Discord[/url] server, and we'll be happy to assist you.

Stay vigilant!

[i]Best,
Untold Tales and Kautki Cave[/i]

notes.title: DevBlog 1: the perks dojo
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

[h2]Welcome to the perks dojo![/h2]

In the next update, Ignis is going to practice some new kicks  on the enemies he's going to face: we're adding perks to the game, run-specific upgrades that you unlock after bringing a lantern to the Flame,
choose your playstyle as you make your way through the monster hordes!

Here's what it's going to look like:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iTNzAuo.jpg[/img]

Offensive, or defensive, many interesting perk combinations will give you an edge in your battle against obscurity!

I leave the mic to [i]Paweł [/i]from the dev team to explain the [i]whys[/i] and [i]hows[/i] of this new addition:

[quote=Paweł][i]We decided to implement Perks for a few reasons:

[h3][b]1. Roguelite element and better replayability.[/b][/h3]
Flame Keeper had some basic rogue-lite mechanics but we were missing some greater gameplay randomization so that every new run could be more diverse. Now after putting a lantern around the fireplace you can pick 1 out of 3 random perks. They have a great influence on your playstyle and add a lot of fun and variation even if you are replaying the same stage.

[h3][b]2. Reward for your sacrifice: more fun more often.[/b][/h3]
Before perks were implemented, the player was charging the fireplace with their own life energy to win. It was some kind of reward but we were missing something more enjoyable and more frequent. Therefore we decided to fill that gap by giving a new perk exactly after the lantern is brought to the fireplace to reward you for giving your life.

[h3][b]3. Enemies respawn - update.[/b][/h3]
In the current version of the game, enemies just respawn after some time. It was sometimes annoying when they did so just in front of you when you were peacefully bringing a lantern to the fireplace. Now enemies respawn after the lantern is loaded in the fireplace. That makes exploring the map a much nicer experience, because your influence on it (killed enemies, peaceful regions) lasts longer you can decide when you want to respawn them (and thus plan how much risk you're willing to take).
[/i]
[/quote]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/t83Wrut.jpg[/img]

That's what we've been cooking, we're excited to hear your feedback in the comment section, see you soon for more updates, and don't forget to check the roadmap to get a taste of what's coming!

Signed: [i]The Kautki Cave team and Untold Tales[/i]

notes.title: Work in progress on the "Lethal Update"
notes.content:
[h3]Dear protectors of the Orbis,[/h3]

It's time for a little sneak peek of our upcoming "[b]Lethal Update[/b]", which will be released somewhere within a month from now.

Two major improvements are:

[b]PERKS[/b]
Players can now select one of three random perks after each lamp charge, allowing for diverse Ignis builds every playthrough. The perks will disappear after each death or return to the village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/9c1233dc992dbbd3a93758d01b6df49238ff7565.png[/img]

[b]WEAPONS[/b]
Each forge level in the village unlocks a new tier of weapons that can be found during gameplay. Each tier features a unique modifier on the final combo hit (slow, poison, burn).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/a40bd094b556cc82db47a2ef8a9cf53be80aaa20.png[/img]

Then there are smaller, yet key fixes we intend to introduce:

[list]
[*][b]DIFFICULTY LEVELS[/b] -> choose from easy, normal, or hard at the beginning of each game, or adjust it anytime in the settings.
[*][b]STAMINA BAR[/b] -> the stamina bar is now located beneath Ignis for improved visibility.
[*][b]COMBAT DUMM[/b]Y -> practice your attack combinations and damage output in the village.
[*][b]WIDESCREEN[/b] -> widescreen support would be added.
[*][b]LAMPS & RUNES[/b] -> added extra effects to make dropped lamps and runes easier to find.
[/list]
Here's also a look at a neat stone punch WIP animation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/aeef9073a3d39a86496f8ab4eed8fbb746b95696.gif[/img]

---

Now, also last week we had an amazing opportunity to answer some questions from our Flaming community on[b] r/nintendoswitch[/b]. We thought that maybe some of those answers could be helpful for a broader audience so we decided to share a few of them here with you!

[b]▶ What was your biggest inspiration for Flame Keeper and why? If I had to guess I’d go with Cult of a Lamb :)[/b]

[i]Cult of the Lamb was a good inspiration when we started developing the Vulpis Village but it was quite late in our timeline. Initially, we were heavily influenced by Hades and we drew a lot from Children of Morta. Generally, we tried to explore this genre and try to find solutions that we liked the most and make them in our own style. We liked Hades for its dynamic combat and we were trying to keep this in our game, and we like a lot of the solutions from Children of Morta like the sequence of stage 1, stage 2, the boss and then the next biome. We also liked the random items, abilities and character upgrades.[/i]

[b]▶ About the weapons you want to add. Do you mean equippable ones? Like sword, shield etc? Thx[/b]

[i]Weapons will be more like temporary basic attack upgrades. They will drop from totems (small ones that you charge by your own energy and bigger ones that you need to find a rune to open). They will have some durability and they will override basic attacks. The last combo attack adds modificators depending on weapon type: slow, poison, burn. They are also divided into 3 groups by their attack speed, damage and distance. So in general it makes 9 weapons for now. Of course, you will have to build a blacksmith hut in the village first to unlock weapons. [/i]

[b]▶ What was the hardest part of developing the game?[/b]

[i]I think the hardest part was accepting some elements as it is. Many game mechanics were a prototype first, which we then extended, got feedback on, and that we changed again, and there always were some elements that I know can be done better, but at some point, we have to accept it even though we know that we can still make some changes. Otherwise, we would never have finished it :) So in general, planning, management, and sticking to it.[/i]

---

That is all for today!
If you still have some questions that you would like to ask us - you can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cYVNyfdwtq]discord[/url] anytime and we will be happy to provide you with the answers!

Have a great day! 🔥
Flame Keeper team
